Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Rear camera with washer - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. Even if there are sloppy conditions, the washer keeps the camera's view clean. Rear camera with washer is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped.   • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

Six speakers deliver clear sound quality, while a USB auxiliary input allows for easy connection of external devices, making every drive entertaining and connected.

2021 Kia Soul Performance Features

Its smooth automatic transmission and front-wheel drive setup ensure a comfortable, responsive driving experience, whether you're navigating city streets or highway routes.

The hands-free power liftgate opens to a big cargo area with a cargo shade and a seat-back protector, and the rear seats fold for longer gear.     Safety and Security
    • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
    • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
    • Rear camera with washer - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. Even if there are sloppy conditions, the washer keeps the camera's view clean. Rear camera with washer is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe
    Technology and Telematics
    • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

The Blind Spot Detection system monitors your vehicles sides while Rear Cross Traffic Alert warns you of approaching vehicles when backing up, giving you the awareness needed in all driving situations.

This Outback Premium combines everyday practicality with the dependable engineering Subaru is known for, whether youre managing family responsibilities, exploring new destinations, or simply enjoying the road ahead. The vehicles straightforward controls and intuitive layout minimize distractions, allowing you to focus on driving.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this capable vehicle firsthand and discuss how it aligns with your transportation needs.

description: Standout styling. Outstanding fuel economy. Surprising versatility. This 2023 Kia Soul S proves that practical transportation doesn't have to be ordinary. With its distinctive design, impressive 35 MPG highway rating, modern smartphone connectivity, and spacious interior, the Soul delivers the personality of a fun urban crossover with the affordability and efficiency of a compact car. Finished in sleek Fusion Black with a Black Premium Woven and Tricot Cloth interior, this Soul S brings a bold, contemporary look to everyday driving. Its signature upright profile, distinctive front-end styling, and compact dimensions make it instantly recognizable, while the elevated roofline creates an interior that feels remarkably spacious for its size. Under the hood is a naturally aspirated 2.0-liter four-cylinder paired with an Intelligent Variable Transmission, delivering smooth everyday performance and excellent efficiency. With an EPA-estimated 29 MPG city and 35 MPG highway, this Soul is an outstanding choice for commuters looking to keep fuel costs manageable without sacrificing comfort or practicality. Whether you're navigating Seattle traffic, commuting across the Eastside, or heading out for a weekend adventure, the Soul offers an easygoing driving experience with excellent maneuverability and a comfortable seating position. But what makes the Kia Soul especially appealing is its clever use of space. The tall roofline provides generous headroom, while the roomy cabin offers comfortable seating for five. The split-folding rear seats allow you to expand the cargo area for groceries, luggage, outdoor equipment, or larger everyday purchases. You get the versatility people love about crossovers without the size or expense of a traditional SUV. Inside, the S trim delivers the technology and conveniences that matter most. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto bring your favorite navigation apps, music, and smartphone features directly into the infotainment system. A six-speaker audio system with AM/FM/MP3/HD Radio provides entertainment, while steering-wheel-mounted audio controls keep essential functions conveniently within reach. A power-adjustable driver's seat, air conditioning, cruise control, remote keyless entry, and a telescoping steering wheel help make every drive comfortable and convenient. The rearview camera adds confidence when backing into parking spaces, especially in crowded city environments. With 56,254 miles, this 2023 Soul S represents an appealing opportunity to enjoy a relatively recent model year, modern connectivity, and excellent fuel economy without paying new-car prices. For buyers comparing compact sedans, hatchbacks, and small SUVs, the Soul offers something refreshingly different. Its upright design provides impressive interior flexibility, its compact footprint makes parking easy, and its distinctive styling gives it more personality than many conventional commuter cars. Discover the 2017 Subaru Outback 2.5i Limited, a versatile wagon built for adventure and comfort. With only 44,521 miles, this Tungsten Metallic beauty combines reliability with advanced technology. Its naturally aspirated 2.5-liter four-cylinder engine produces 175 horsepower at 5800 rpm and 174 lb-ft of torque at 4000 rpm, offering a balanced mix of power and efficiency. Equipped with an automatic transmission and full-time AWD, this vehicle is ready to handle diverse road conditions. Inside, you'll find a Warm Ivory interior that complements the sleek Gray exterior, providing a refined look. The Outback includes premium features such as adaptive cruise control, a backup camera, blind spot monitor, Bluetooth connectivity, collision warning, cross traffic alert, heated seats, keyless entry, lane keep assist, memory seats, navigation system, premium audio, push start, rear heated seats, satellite radio readiness, and a sunroof/moonroof. Notable installed options include Subaru’s EyeSight driver assist system, a 7-inch Starlink multimedia navigation system with HD radio and a single-disc CD player, voice controls, Bluetooth streaming, iPod integration, SiriusXM subscription services, real-time traffic updates, and high beam assist with HID headlights. These features combine to deliver a driving experience that is both secure and connected.

2017 Subaru Outback Safety and Security Features

This Outback prioritizes safety with dual front seat cushion airbags and rear parking sensors that help prevent collisions. Its four-wheel anti-lock braking system (ABS) offers stability during emergency stops, while the power door locks include anti-lockout functions for added security. Cornering brake control enhances handling around curves, and the electronic parking brake with auto-off function provides convenience and safety during parking maneuvers.

2017 Subaru Outback Entertainment and Technology Features

Equipped with an 11-speaker audio system, this Outback delivers rich sound through a 7-inch touchscreen infotainment display. It supports HD radio, voice-operated controls, and internet radio apps like Pandora, providing entertainment options for every taste. The system includes a subwoofer and 576-watt amplification, ensuring clear, powerful audio. Smartphone integration through MySubaru app adds convenience, while real-time traffic data keeps you informed. This vehicle is designed to keep you connected and entertained on every journey.

2017 Subaru Outback Performance Features

The Outback’s full-time 4WD system ensures consistent traction and stability, making it an excellent choice for varied terrains and weather conditions. Its balanced performance and reliable drivetrain deliver confidence behind the wheel, whether on city streets or off-road adventures.

Visit us to experience this practical, spirited wagon and see why the Golf Alltrack stands out in its class.

Entertainment and technology are prioritized with a DVD navigation system and compatibility with Volvo Cars smart device apps, enabling remote engine start and cabin preconditioning. The system features 11 speakers delivering 650 watts of power for immersive sound, enhanced by surround sound technology and a dedicated subwoofer. The 7-inch infotainment screen provides real-time traffic updates and easy access to navigation data, ensuring efficient routes. HD radio adds clarity to audio, making every trip more enjoyable with seamless connectivity and modern convenience.

2015 Volvo V60 Performance Features

Performance is optimized with auto start/stop functionality, which aids fuel efficiency and reduces emissions. The tuned suspension offers a touring setup that balances comfort and handling, making long drives smoother and more controlled. These features ensure that the V60 delivers a confident, refined driving experience while maintaining practicality and efficiency.
